method_note: die_area = bits*cell_area/array_efficiency; GDPW = pi*(d/2)^2/A - pi*d/sqrt(2A); $/GB = wafer_cost/(GDPW*yield*Gb_per_die/8) + test_pkg. Values marked [ESTIMATE]/[UNVERIFIED] are A2 assumptions (research/assumptions/A2.md).
